defs.def: not the same as sb/sth; not like sb/sth else 不同的；有区别的；有差异的

ex.s: Now I understand that although my son may be learning differently, he is still learning.
ex.t: 现在我明白了，尽管儿子的学习方式可能不同，但他仍在学习。

ex.s: Instead, encourage them to do differently next time.
ex.t: 相反，鼓励他们下次换一种不同的做法。

ex.s: The authors of Movement have it right: it’s time to think differently about that street outside your front door.
ex.t: 《运动》一书的作者说得对：是时候换一种方式看待你家门前那条街道了。

ex.s: There you will find them prepared differently- more dumpling and less soup, and the wrappers are pressed ____40____ hand rather than rolled.
ex.t: 在那里你会发现它们的做法不同——馅更多、汤更少，而且面皮是用手按压而非擀制出来的。

ex.s: “We have students who say they went home and talked to their parents and now they’re eating differently,” Jaramillo says.
ex.t: 贾拉米洛说：“我们有学生回家和父母聊过之后，现在的饮食方式就不同了。”

ex.s: The clear front of the box had a “keyhole” in a geometric shape, and the birds were given five differently shaped “keys” to choose from.
ex.t: 盒子透明的正面有一个几何形状的“钥匙孔”，鸟儿们会得到五个形状各异的“钥匙”供选择。

ex.s: Multiple genes behaved differently, depending on whether someone had eaten or not before walking.
ex.t: 多个基因的表现因人步行前是否进食而有所不同。

ex.s: Everybody uses a keyboard and everybody types differently.
ex.t: 人人都用键盘，每个人的打字方式都不同。

ex.s: Though I lived _____42_____ three and a half hours away, most of my classmates thought of Ohio as a whole different world.
ex.t: 尽管我住在三个半小时车程之外，大多数同学却把俄亥俄当作一个完全不同的世界。

ex.s: Even those who didn’t share that interest with me seemed more engaged once I showed a different side of myself.
ex.t: 即便是那些和我没有共同兴趣的人，在我展现出不同的一面之后，似乎也更投入了。

ex.s: We’re just different.”
ex.t: 我们只是不一样罢了。

ex.s: The pronunciation system of the Chinese language is quite different from that of English.
ex.t: 汉语的语音系统与英语的语音系统大不相同。

ex.s: But Mark had a different idea.
ex.t: 但马克有一个不同的想法。

ex.s: You’ll compete with fewer tourists, save money, experience a different side of a popular place, and boost the economy when tourism is traditionally slower.
ex.t: 你将与更少的游客竞争、省钱、体验热门地点不一样的一面，并在传统旅游淡季提振当地经济。

ex.s: Born just before WWII, my grandmother ____23____ an entirely different childhood lifestyle from mine.
ex.t: 奶奶出生于二战前夕，她的童年生活方式与我的完全不同。

ex.s: All plants are different
ex.t: 所有植物都各不相同。

ex.s: And above all, stories have a transformative power to allow us to see the world in a different way than we do if we just encounter it on our own.
ex.t: 最重要的是，故事具有改变的力量，让我们以不同于独自面对世界的方式去看世界。

ex.s: In what way is a routine different from a habit?
ex.t: 常规和习惯有什么不同？

ex.s: In which aspect were the two groups different in terms of research design?
ex.t: 两组在研究设计上有什么不同？

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时大不相同，我们大多数自然的“法则”也是如此。

ex.s: Parisians are different from you and me.
ex.t: 巴黎人与你我不同。

ex.s: It is different from traditional tourism because it allows the traveler to become 61 (educate) about the areas - both in terms of geographical conditions and cultural characteristics, and often provides money for conservation and benefits the 62 (develop) of the local areas.
ex.t: 它不同于传统旅游，因为它让旅行者了解该地区——无论是地理条件还是文化特征——并常常为保护提供资金，惠及当地的发展。

ex.s: The researchers then tested the dogs’ ability to distinguish between human facial expressions by showing them the other half of the person’s face or images totally different from the ones used in training.
ex.t: 研究人员随后通过展示人脸的另一半或与训练所用完全不同的图像，测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: Pictures used in the two stages were different
ex.t: 两个阶段使用的图片是不同的。

ex.s: But they had to live with who they were after everything was different.
ex.t: 但他们不得不在一切都变得不同后，接受真实的自己。

ex.s: I experienced years of loneliness as a child. ___31___ His friends teased him about babysitting his sister and his interests were far different from mine.
ex.t: 我童年时经历过数年的孤独。___31___他的朋友们取笑他要照顾妹妹，他的兴趣与我的截然不同。

ex.s: Even though there is a common spirit among all music groups, they make very different music. ___31___ At that time the Beatles entered the world of music from Liverpool.
ex.t: 尽管所有音乐团体都有一种共同的精神，它们创作的音乐却大不相同。___31___那时披头士从利物浦进入音乐世界。

ex.s: The style of the campus is quite different from that of most Chinese universities.
ex.t: 校园的风格与大多数中国大学大不相同。

ex.s: This time, however, the cleanup was a little different.
ex.t: 但这一次，清理工作有点不同。

ex.s: What is different for the speaker to get used to?
ex.t: 对说话者来说，有什么不同之处需要适应？

ex.s: It is different from British English in several ways, mostly in spelling and vocabulary.
ex.t: 它在几个方面与英式英语不同，主要在拼写和词汇上。

ex.s: Here are some of our favourites, to remind us that some of the English we learn in the classroom is rather different from the English in the outside world!
ex.t: 以下是我们最喜欢的一些例子，它们提醒我们，在课堂上学到的一些英语与外界的英语大不相同！

ex.s: Art is deeply personal, because when two people see the same artwork, our perception can create vastly different experiences of meaning.
ex.t: 艺术是高度个人化的，因为当两个人看到同一件艺术品时，我们的感知能创造出截然不同的意义体验。

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: One of the ground rules of the swap should be that everyone must try on the clothes before they take them—things always look different when you put them on.
ex.t: 交换的基本规则之一是每个人必须在拿走衣服前试穿——衣服穿在身上时看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: It tailors learning experiences to different age groups and learning styles.
ex.t: 它针对不同年龄段和学习风格量身定制学习体验。

ex.s: “We’re not just ‘borrowing’ from different disciplines — we’re really putting them on equal footing in order to create something greater than the sum of its parts.”
ex.t: “我们不只是从不同学科‘借用’——我们真正让它们处于平等地位，以创造出大于各部分之和的东西。”

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 雪——已受到气候变暖的威胁——随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变它清冷的气味。

ex.s: Here’s the breakdown of the emissions in 2018 for different modes of transport.
ex.t: 以下是2018年不同交通方式排放的细分情况。

ex.s: How does a pet cat assess different situations?
ex.t: 宠物猫如何评估不同的情况？

ex.s: Of course, I would have preferred a different ending for Tom and Maggie Tulliver, but the ending they got did make the most sense for them.
ex.t: 当然，我本希望汤姆和玛吉·塔利弗有一个不同的结局，但他们得到的结局对他们来说确实最合理。

ex.s: I guess our different childhood background is what makes my grandmother such an amazing person to ____39____ to: her stories always make my history textbooks ____40____.
ex.t: 我想，正是我们不同的童年背景，让奶奶成为一个如此值得____（敬佩）的人：她的故事总让我的历史课本变得____（生动）。

ex.s: To compare different kinds of seeding methods.
ex.t: 比较不同种类的播种方法。

ex.s: The Language Exchange Programme allows students in pairs to communicate in two different languages they wish to share and learn each week.
ex.t: 语言交换项目让学生两人一组，每周用他们希望分享和学习的两种不同语言交流。

ex.s: Little by little, these different kinds of life got used to one another and formed their own ecosystem.
ex.t: 渐渐地，这些不同的生命形式相互适应，形成了自己的生态系统。

ex.s: To compare John’s different jobs.
ex.t: 比较约翰的不同工作。

ex.s: They are from different countries.
ex.t: 他们来自不同的国家。

ex.s: In this “book of books,” artworks are selected and arranged in a way that emphasizes these connections between different eras and cultures.
ex.t: 在这本“书中的书”里，艺术作品的挑选和编排方式突出了不同时代和文化之间的联系。

ex.s: To compare different types of park-goers.
ex.t: 为了比较不同类型的游园者。

ex.s: The same nature experience takes different forms.
ex.t: 同一种自然体验可以呈现不同的形式。

ex.s: According to a new study from market analysts, 1 in 5 Britons say that watching cookery programmes on TV has encouraged them to try different food.
ex.t: 根据市场分析师的一项新研究，五分之一的英国人表示，看电视烹饪节目促使他们尝试不同的食物。

ex.s: How are campers divided into different groups?
ex.t: 营员是如何被分成不同小组的？

ex.s: If TMS is applied to a specific part of your brain behind your forehead that is particularly important for decision-making, you suddenly like different kinds of art.
ex.t: 如果经颅磁刺激（TMS）作用于额头后方对决策尤为重要的大脑特定区域，你会突然喜欢上不同类型的艺术。

ex.s: Now, more evidence has been provided that dogs distinguish between similar actions associated with different intentions.
ex.t: 如今有更多证据表明，狗能区分与不同意图相关的相似行为。

ex.s: What do the dogs’ different responses in “unwilling” and “unable” scenarios suggest?
ex.t: 狗在“不愿”和“不能”两种情境下不同的反应说明了什么？

ex.s: Stories are an entry point to understanding a different experience of the world.
ex.t: 故事是理解世界不同体验的切入点。

ex.s: This aspect of storytelling-presenting a different perspective of the world—is important when it comes to connecting with each other.
ex.t: 讲故事的这一面——呈现世界的不同视角——在彼此建立联系时很重要。

ex.s: “It’s good to have a different focus.
ex.t: “有一个不同的关注点真好。”

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类语音包含2000多种不同的声音，从常见的“m”“a”到某些南部非洲语言中罕见的咔嗒声。

ex.s: You and your partner will probably have different skills. ___40___ Over time, both of you will benefit — your partner will be able to lift more weights and you will become more physically fit.
ex.t: 你和你的搭档可能有不同的技能。___40___随着时间的推移，你们双方都会受益——你的搭档能举起更重的重量，而你也会变得更健康。

ex.s: Grouping toys of different shapes.
ex.t: 将不同形状的玩具分组。

ex.s: travel to different places.
ex.t: 去不同的地方旅行。

ex.s: There are different levels of exercises for different age groups and we must do them according to our own health and age.
ex.t: 不同年龄段有不同的运动强度，我们必须根据自身健康和年龄来进行。

ex.s: It picks up delicate objects in different ways.
ex.t: 它以不同的方式拾取易碎物体。

ex.s: ●Put different types of clothing on different surfaces in the room.____19____.
ex.t: 把不同类型的衣物放在房间里不同的表面上。____19____。

ex.s: At this point, it is not clear why dogs seem to be equipped with the ability to recognize different facial expressions in humans.
ex.t: 目前还不清楚为什么狗似乎具备识别人类不同面部表情的能力。

ex.s: This happened over and over, but we soon learned to identify different grasses like cockleburs, lamb’s-quarters, foxtails, and the king of weeds, the pretty purple thistle.
ex.t: 这种情况反复发生，但我们很快学会了辨认不同的草，如苍耳、藜、狗尾草，以及杂草之王——美丽的紫色蓟。

ex.t: 在中国艺术节上，有不同的摊位，艺术家们在那里展示技艺并指导参观者。

ex.s: Then I would try to remember the different possessions I supposedly had taken away—since I seldom actually kept them.
ex.t: 然后我会试图回想那些据说被我拿走的不同的物品——因为我其实很少真的把它们留下。

ex.t: 为什么不同树木的枝叶会避免相互接触？

ex.s: A new study of different plants.
ex.t: 一项关于不同植物的新研究。

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总用不同的声音朗读，仿佛在用声音演绎故事，他们很喜欢！那是与孩子们亲密相处的特别时光，充满书籍带来的惊奇。

ex.s: Lifestyles in different countries.
ex.t: 不同国家的生活方式。

ex.s: It analyzed different kinds of parenting styles.
ex.t: 它分析了不同种类的育儿方式。

ex.s: different choices of music for businesses
ex.t: 企业不同的音乐选择

ex.s: Our courses, totalling 20,000 hours of content in 20 different languages, guarantee you language skills you can use right away.
ex.t: 我们的课程总计2万小时内容，涵盖20种不同的语言，保证你掌握可立即使用的语言技能。

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备收集的数据可根据打字方式识别不同的参与者，错误率极低。

ex.s: They appear different forms.
ex.t: 它们以不同的形式出现。

ex.t: 从我还是个孩子起，我就考虑过我想从事的不同工作。

ex.t: 摇滚乐由许多不同的风格组成。

ex.t: 在那里，他不得不在一些不同的商店或餐馆____49____后才能找到食物。

ex.t: 食物是我们每周最大的家庭开支，苏珊娜和马特每周都会与不同的家庭共度时光。

ex.t: 多年来，有许多不同的技术帮助设计师处理这一要点。

ex.t: 王收集了700多万块不同年代的废弃砖块。

ex.t: 它们释放专门设计来吸引不同昆虫的香气，这些昆虫正是攻击者的天敌。

ex.s: The researchers call the effect “enclothed cognition,” suggesting that all manner of different clothes probably affect our cognition in many different ways.
ex.t: 研究人员称之为“着装认知”效应，认为各种各样不同的衣服可能以许多不同的方式影响我们的认知。

ex.t: 有些植物释放难闻的化学物质驱赶昆虫。但另一些则一举两得。它们释放专门设计来吸引不同昆虫的香气，而这些昆虫正是攻击者的天敌。一旦它们到来，形势就逆转了。正在用餐的攻击者现在成了盘中餐。

ex.t: 从事不同工作的人应该穿不同的衣服。

ex.t: 我们可以设想罗伯特国王故事的另一个版本。

ex.t: 你如何将“移向另一个角落”的想法运用到现实生活中的挑战中？
